limits: One instrumented 5-second sample per API; shared host, no repeated A/B throughput or latency acceptance.
Volatile tmpfs WAL retains ordinary Raft quorum/sync calls; no disk or power-loss claim.
Only on-CPU samples: percentages are not end-to-end latency fractions.
Inclusive recovered stacks overlap and are not additive. Optimized code/async boundaries limit unwinding.
Unmeasured idle followers need not cover every interval; aggregate 32-bin coverage is checked.
No prior executable instruction offsets are reused.
